critical_code_review_comments: server.py:619 correctly places the plannings.delete_one BEFORE the return of the fresh-completion branch — the already-completed branch (line ~589) does NOT delete, which is verified by test_replay_completion_still_leaves_planning_absent. This is the correct semantic: only fresh completions consume the planning.

server.py:663-705 planning endpoints use plain family_id (no auth check). Consistent with the rest of the app which does the same for family-scoped resources — flag only if the security model tightens later. Not blocking.

PlanningPicker.tsx:47 describePlanning() returns lowercase slot label ('vendredi apéro'), but home CSS/style capitalizes it ('Vendredi Apéro') as observed — visually correct. In the session PlanningStep no describe() is shown so no issue.

PlanningCreate model (server.py:178) does NOT validate time_slot against the enum documented in the review request; POST with an arbitrary string would succeed. All 8 documented slot values round-trip fine (verified) — enforce validation only if you want to lock the value space. Not a bug.
